blocks.text: Day 6 · A day trip to Bartolomé, a young volcanic islet of about 1.2 km² off the east coast of Santiago, with a landscape of red, orange, green and glistening black volcanic formations. Climb to the summit for spectacular views of the surrounding islands and the iconic Pinnacle Rock, then swim and snorkel around it with Galápagos penguins, sea turtles, whitetip reef sharks and tropical fish. (B, L)

paragraphs.text: Day 7 · A day trip to North Seymour or South Plaza. North Seymour, near Baltra, was formed by the uplift of submarine lava and is covered in low, bushy vegetation: along its 2-kilometre trail, see one of the largest nesting colonies of frigatebirds in the Galápagos and blue-footed boobies performing their famous courtship dance. South Plaza, only 0.13 km², has cliffs where red-billed tropicbirds and swallow-tailed gulls nest, prickly-pear cactus trees and a large colony of Galápagos land iguanas; its sesuvium ground cover turns from green in the rainy season to orange and purple in the dry season. (B, L)

After breakfast, another day at sea begins.

The specific island is confirmed after booking.

**Option 2. South Plaza**

After the walk, continue to **Punta Carrión**.

Lunch is served on board.

Here you can swim and snorkel.

In the water, you may encounter rays, reef sharks, Galápagos sharks and a wide variety of tropical fish.

Return to the hotel after the excursion.

Free evening.

Accommodation at **Fiesta 3***.

**Meals:** breakfast and lunch.
